messages.subject: Workshop in data visualization
parts:
Hi y'all – The MGSA (Mexican graduate association is sponsoring another workshop, this time in data visualization with R. The workshop will be on Thu July 6th from 9am to 2 pm. Feel free to come by and hang out. Workshop is in English, but documentation and help is provided in Spanish and Portuguese as well. 
Check out the workshop website for more info on the schedule: https://www.spablo-temporal.network/DataViz-workshop/

registration link: http://bit.ly/data_viz2
